# Official GAEB schemas

Unmodified schema files from the GAEB download area:
https://www.gaeb.de/de/service/downloads/gaeb-datenaustausch/

`sources.json` records the source archives and their SHA-256 checksums.
Copyright and attribution in the original files remain intact. The schemas are
provided by GAEB/DIN; they are not covered by the application's AGPL license.

The editor bundles the LV schemas for X80–X87, X52 cost calculations, X89 invoices,
and X93/X94/X96/X97 trade exchanges (3.3, 2021-05), the X31 schema
(3.3, 2023-01), and the previous 3.2/3.1 LV schemas. XSD includes are resolved
exclusively from these bundled files in a browser worker. Document-provided URLs
are never used to download schemas.
